The '''Fobosi District''' was a district on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] adjacent to [[The Works/Legends|The Works]].

The Fobosi District contained the elite centers of business and commerce planning for Coruscant and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a whole. It was the location of the [[Skydome Botanical Gardens/Legends|Skydome Botanical Gardens]], the headquarters of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]], the [[Fobosi District Medcenter]], and the central administration building of the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]].
